representation: Frozen cropped grayscale ECG page image. CNN output pooled to 64x2x16; each of 16 left-to-right spatial positions supplies 128 features to one LSTM. This is not calibrated physiological time or waveform digitization.
selection_rule: Strict lexicographic maximum of validation (macro_f1, balanced_accuracy, -weighted_loss). Earliest epoch for exact ties. Patience counts epochs without tuple improvement.
search_budget: One prespecified configuration and seed; at most 30 epochs; no hyperparameter search
comparison_limit: Both architecture and checkpoint-selection criterion differ from original CNN (minimum validation loss). This is a pipeline comparison, not an isolated LSTM architecture ablation.
preprocessing_limit: Unchanged low-resolution baseline crop; confirmed clipping in one inspected training page and aspect distortion remain. The separate crop preview is not adopted.
test_policy: Previously observed test set. One final inference after weights, configuration and selection are frozen. Exploratory comparison; no test tuning or new confirmatory claim.
